placements.title: Strategic positioning and directional choices
placements.theme: What an organization chooses to own versus rent defines its strategic position.

placements.title: From rented substrate to owned perspective
placements.theme: Intelligence you own comes from the perspective you keep, not the substrate you rent.
placements.why: src-2 draws the owned/rented distinction, src-3 supplies the asset/commodity split (perspective is the asset, substrate is the commodity), and src-4 names this as the individually-owned-intelligence thesis. Together they state a directional subject — what makes intelligence owned rather than rented — that future envelopes will keep feeding, passing the narrative grain test.
